name: Anemoy Capital

repos.scope: Centrifuge protocol V3 indexer: pools, vaults, share classes, holdings, investor flows, cross-chain messaging. Anemoy Capital funds are Centrifuge pools, so they are indexed here.
repos.verified: WebFetch of repo confirms Ponder indexer (ponder.config.ts, ponder.schema.ts) indexing EVM events for Centrifuge pools/vaults; 399 commits, latest release v3.8.1 May 2026, prod GraphQL at api.centrifuge.io

notes: Anemoy is an issuer of RWA funds on Centrifuge; covered by official Centrifuge api-v3 Ponder indexer.

name: WisdomTree
notes: Institutional/custodial tokenized funds (WisdomTree Prime/Connect). No public subgraph/indexer repo found; no public github org with indexing code.

name: Raydium AMM
notes: Solana-only AMM (raydium-io/raydium-amm is the on-chain Rust program, not an indexer). The Graph hosted subgraphs index EVM, not Solana state. No public Ponder/SubQuery/Subsquid indexer for Raydium found; analytics rely on Solana RPC/Geyser, not a public git indexer repo.

name: Concrete
notes: ERC-4626 vault protocol by Blueprint Finance. Docs reference an internal subgraph indexing deposits/withdrawals/yield but no public repo is published. Only public github is the code-423n4/2024-11-concrete audit repo (contracts, not an indexer). CONCRETE-Project github org is an unrelated Bitcoin payments app. Marked false: no public indexer repo found.

name: SwissBorg
notes: Centralized exchange. No public subgraph/indexer repo (SwissBorg github org has wallet/KYC infra, no protocol indexer).

name: Invesco USTB
notes: Tokenized US T-bill fund issued via Superstate (USTB token). superstateinc github org has only token/contract repos (ustb, onchain-redemptions) plus DefiLlama adapters, no subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Binance Staked SOL
notes: Binance custodial Solana staking (BNSOL). Solana-only, custodial; no public indexer repo. Marked false.

name: Uniswap V2

repos.scope: Official Uniswap V2 subgraph: tracks the V2 factory, all pairs, mints/burns/swaps, liquidity and USD-derived stats.
repos.verified: WebFetch of repo confirms official Uniswap org, ~299 commits on main, config/src/abis dirs, TypeScript subgraph; actively maintained.

notes: Official Uniswap V2 subgraph by Uniswap. (Older ianlapham/uniswap-v2-subgraph is the legacy mirror.)

name: Function FBTC
notes: Wrapped/bridged BTC (FBTC) with custodial mint/redeem. fbtc-xyz github org has only fbtc-contract (Solidity contracts, last updated 2024), no subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange
notes: Solana-only perps DEX. Only community IDL-parsing samples (julianfssen/jupiter-perps-anchor-idl-parsing) and SDKs exist, plus closed-source program. No official or community public indexer/subgraph indexing Jupiter Perps. Marked false.

name: Jito Liquid Staking
notes: JitoSOL liquid staking on Solana via the spl-stake-pool program. No public subgraph/indexer repo (Solana, off-chain analytics via RPC). Marked false.

name: Uniswap V4

repos.scope: Official Uniswap V4 subgraph: PoolManager, pools, hooks, swaps/modifyLiquidity across multiple chains (networks.json).
repos.verified: Official Uniswap org repo confirmed via search; multi-chain config via networks.json. Also an official Envio alternative exists (enviodev/uniswap-v4-indexer).
Search result confirms it is a multichain Uniswap V4 indexer; community/Envio-maintained.

notes: Official Uniswap V4 subgraph plus an Envio multichain indexer.

name: Lista Lending
notes: Lista DAO lending (moolah). lista-dao github org (17 repos) has contracts, lending-sdk, MCP server and AI skills but no subgraph/indexer/ponder/subsquid repo. Marked false.

name: StakeWise V2

repos.scope: StakeWise V2 subgraphs: ethereum + stakewise subgraphs covering V2 contracts (sETH2, rETH2, pool, rewards) plus a uniswap-v3 subgraph for StakeWise token pairs.
repos.verified: WebFetch confirms repo with ethereum/stakewise/uniswap-v3 subgraphs referencing sETH2/rETH2; 69 commits, last release v1.5.0 Oct 2022 (V2 is legacy, hence stale).

notes: Official StakeWise V2 subgraphs repo. V2 is the legacy product (V3 has stakewise/v3-subgraph); the V2 subgraph repo is stale but is the correct scope for this entry.

name: Obol
notes: Obol distributed validator technology. ObolNetwork github has contracts (obol-splits) and Go infra (charon) but no subgraph/indexer/ponder repo (org search for subgraph/indexer/ponder returned 0). Marked false.

name: Fluid Lending
notes: Fluid (by Instadapp) lending/vault/liquidity layer. Contracts public (Instadapp/fluid-contracts-public) but no public subgraph/indexer for Fluid lending markets: Instadapp org has no subgraph/fluid/indexer repo; existing 'instadapp' subgraphs (PierrickGT, protofire DSA) index the older DeFi Smart Accounts, not Fluid. Fluid governance has an 'Build the Instadapp Subgraph [In-Progress]' bounty; data is served via on-chain FluidVaultResolver. Marked false.

name: Optimism Bridge
notes: Canonical OP Stack L1<>L2 bridge. The bridge contracts live in ethereum-optimism/optimism (Optimism monorepo) but that is protocol/infra code, not a TVL/deposit indexer for the bridge as a DefiLlama protocol. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer repo scoped to the canonical bridge. Marked false.

name: Liquid Collective
notes: LsETH liquid staking. liquid-collective/liquid-collective-protocol holds the smart contracts only; reporting/accounting is via Alluvial's proprietary enterprise API, not a public subgraph/indexer. No public indexer repo found. Marked false.

name: Lombard LBTC
notes: LBTC liquid Bitcoin. lombard-finance github org (25 repos) has SDK, EVM/Solana/Sui/Starknet contracts, deposit-address tooling, but no subgraph/indexer/ponder/subsquid repo. Marked false.

name: OSL HK
notes: Centralized/custodial exchange (Hong Kong). No public subgraph/indexer repo. Marked false.
